Overview

The economics of Cloud, Edge & Platform for 3PL & Freight Forwarding flipped in the last two years: runtimes got durable, evaluation became routine, and orchestration frameworks matured into something you can run under change control. What separates winners now is integration discipline — how cleanly the capability plugs into TMS execution without inventing a shadow estate. The Logistics & Supply Chain operating reality gives this work its shape: dwell time pressure at event speed, GDPR / privacy regimes obligations on every artifact, and practitioners who will not accept recommendations they cannot interrogate. The pattern below is calibrated to those three forces.
